item.title: ‘No one deserves this’: Ontario snowplow operator attack sparks concern
item.description: The safety of snow removal workers was highlighted again when a Peterborough, Ont., resident opened the cab of a machine and tried to remove the driver's ear protection.

item.title: Indigenous leaders outline priorities for spring sitting of Parliament
item.description: From clean drinking water legislation to self-government and better infrastructure, Indigenous leaders say they're looking for action from Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government.

item.title: Trump says he’s increasing global tariffs to 15%
item.description: Trump announced Saturday he is raising global tariffs to 15 per cent from 10 per cent, following a Supreme Court ruling that invalidated key elements of his trade policy.

item.title: Heli-skier dies in avalanche near Revelstoke, B.C.
item.description: A heli-skier has died after being caught in an avalanche near Revelstoke, B.C., with RCMP and the BC Coroners Service investigating the fatal incident.

item.title: The Curator: 13 best women’s swimsuits to shop in 2026
item.description: From a retro-inspired La Vie en Rose one-piece to leak-proof Knix and shapewear-style Spanx bottoms, discover 13 women’s swimsuits made for a sun-filled escape.

item.title: Ipsos poll suggests Canada more united than in 2019, despite Alberta tensions
item.description: Updated polling suggests measures of alienation have eased since 2019, though Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says tensions with Ottawa remain a concern.

item.title: Federal government raises concerns over OpenAI safety measures after B.C. tragedy
item.description: The federal government responds to reports involving Tumbler Ridge shooter's OpenAI account, while a funeral service for one of the students is canceled after online threats.

item.title: Edmonton propane fire shoots flames ’40 to 50 feet,’ forces home evacuations
item.description: A propane heater fire at an Edmonton construction site forced evacuations from several homes for a few hours near the Clareview Recreation Centre.

item.title: Meet Digit: Toyota’s newest worker doesn’t need coffee breaks
item.description: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada will begin deploying three humanoid ‘Digit’ robots at its Woodstock plant under a new deal with Agility Robotics, following a successful pilot.

item.title: Families gather for Wanuskewin’s 6th annual Kôna Winter Festival
item.description: Despite the dread of winter's return to Saskatchewan, the extra snow was the perfect gift for Wanuskewin, and just in time for the Kôna Winter Festival.
